findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: outdoor_kitchen_list_grill_brands, outdoor_kitchen_open_designer_for_render, outdoor_kitchen_request_formal_quote · Public sink: outdoor_kitchen_start_planning, outdoor_kitchen_list_grill_brands, outdoor_kitchen_price_design, outdoor_kitchen_get_suggestions, outdoor_kitchen_open_designer_for_render, outdoor_kitchen_request_formal_quote · Destructive: outdoor_kitchen_price_design.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
